text:
Put your AI in your Telegram chats. Post and read messages, and route replies to the right session. Start with whoami, then post.
post [channel] <text...>: Send a message; without a channel it goes to the configured default. The answer is the chat and message ID.; returns: Chat and message ID
  text (string): Message text
read [channel] [limit]: Read the messages this bot received, oldest first; without a channel it reads the default.
  limit (int): Number of messages, 1..200; default 20
channels [filter]: Find the chats the bot has seen, optionally by part of the name.
  filter (string): Chat name substring
channel <channel>: See one chat's details.
users [filter]: Find the senders the bot has seen, optionally by part of the name.
  filter (string): Name substring
user <who>: See one sender.
  who (string): User ID or @alias
react <channel> <id> <emoji>: React to a message.
  id (string): Message ID
  emoji (string): Telegram-supported emoji
[destructive] edit <channel> <id> <text...>: Change one of the bot's own messages.
  id (string): Message ID
  text (string): Replacement text
[destructive] delete <channel> <id>: Remove a message when Telegram permits it.
  id (string): Message ID
whoami: See which bot you are talking to and its last polling error, if any.
refused: See the last 20 senders turned away by routing and not on the list; direct Owner and Maintainers only.; role: maintainer
sub add <channel> <target> [filter]: Forward matching chat messages to a destination; the answer is the subscription ID.; returns: Subscription ID
  filter (string): Regex /pattern/flags or plain regex; empty clears an edited filter
sub list: See your subscriptions and their sent and dropped counts; this agent’s direct Owner and Maintainers see all.
[destructive] sub delete <id>: Delete your subscription, or any subscription as this agent’s direct Owner or Maintainer.
  id (string): Subscription ID

Arguments
channel (string): Telegram #alias, @alias or decimal chat ID
target (string): Bus queue or agent destination; the author must be allowed to send to it and this helper

Examples
agent-bus call '#telegram/parf@parf.us' whoami
agent-bus call '#telegram/parf@parf.us' 'sub list'
